transcript: Speaker A: Today, I am going to Dubai. First, I go to the airport. Then, I check in. I show my passport. I get my boarding pass. Next, I drop my luggage. Then, I go to immigration. They check my passport. After that, I go to security check. I put my bag on the scanner. Then, I go to the gate. I wait for my flight. Then, I board the plane. I find my seat and sit down. Finally, I fly to Dubai.
